CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is paired with an explicit processing/origin change on the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions), its presented organization (coordinate set), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Explicit processing provenance/inheritance metadata links a processing/change condition to the same content referent.

C.rationale: The report identifies specific represented contents (grid coordinates) and names an attribute (red).

D.rationale: An origin/status field is separately provided for the same content referent, distinguishing content from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The coordinate sets show how the content is organized/presented as a spatial pattern in the record for the given referent/time.
